en: Hmm... If we put the engine here, the hull bends there... I can't make heads or tails of these plans.
text: Hmm... Dacă punem motorul aici, carena se îndoaie acolo... Nu înțeleg nimic din planurile astea.

en: Oh, sorry! I'm Dock, Captain Stern's foreman. Parts from Devon? For the captain?
text: A, pardon! Sunt Dock, maistrul Căpitanului Stern. Piese de la Devon? Pentru căpitan?

en: He's not here. He went over to the Oceanic Museum. Could you take them to him there?
text: Nu e aici. S-a dus la Muzeul Oceanic. I le poți duce acolo?

en: The captain's at the Oceanic Museum, just up the road. Please get those parts to him!
text: Căpitanul e la Muzeul Oceanic, puțin mai încolo pe drum. Te rog, du-i piesele!

en: Thanks to those parts, the submarine's coming along. But I could use the advice of an old sea hand.
text: Datorită pieselor, submarinul înaintează. Dar mi-ar prinde bine sfatul unui lup de mare bătrân.

en: Hi! Mr. Briney has joined us to lend a hand. With an old sea hand's know-how, the work's going twice as fast!
Hm? Ah, it's you! I've decided to help Dock here. A ship needs an old salt's touch, after all!
